title: diphasium alpinum
intro: Diphasium alpinum, commonly known as Alpine Club Moss, is a species of club moss that belongs to the family Lycopodiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in China and Japan, for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, as well as its ability to boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Diphasium alpinum include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and treat various types of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
